summary: The renewal implementation matches the change delta, but the PR also lowers the standard-member fine cap in direct contradiction to the fines specification. The supplied renewal specifications disagree about the renewal calculation.

findings.message: Lowering STANDARD_FINE_CAP_CENTS from 1,000 to 800 contradicts openspec/specs/fines/spec.md, which requires a 1,000-cent per-loan cap for standard members. Standard loans now stop accruing at 32 completed overdue days instead of accruing up to the required cap.

The changed expectations enforce the unsupported 800-cent standard fine cap and replace assertions of the required 1,000-cent cap. The new two-loan test likewise expects 1,600 cents rather than the required combined 2,000 cents at sufficiently late dates.

The supplied source documents disagree: openspec/specs/loans/spec.md requires renewal from the renewal instant, while this MODIFIED requirement requires renewal from the existing due timestamp. src/loans.ts follows the change delta, consistent with its stated intent to replace the baseline requirement; the baseline specification remains unsynchronized.
